title: Zesty Dense British Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, dense casserole featuring British sausages, passata, and beurre-monte, perfect for a hangover cure. This dish is raw-friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the British sausages to the pan, browning them on all sides, then set aside.
In the same pan, add the passata, beurre-monte, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and the passata mixture, tossing to coat.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of sausages, and finally a layer of shredded cheddar cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
